pages.text: $(bold)Blue$(): Blue is the extreme of attraction. $(br2)$(bold)Blue$() (technique key C): $(li)first press → $(bold)charge$() in hand (blue particles swirl around)$(li)press again → fire a $(bold)sky-blue orb$() straight ahead$(li)the orb $(bold)pulls entities within 10 blocks$() toward its center (the caster excluded)$(li)an entity $(bold)touching the center$() → the orb detonates (area damage)$(li)flies up to $(bold)40 blocks$() and vanishes when it hits a block$(br2)Blast-center damage = (1 + Affinity/100) × (10 + Output×5), falling off with distance.

$(bold)Technique Reversal · Red$() (technique reversal key F): $(li)first press → charge (red particles swirl)$(li)press again → fire a $(bold)bright-red orb$()$(li)Red is Blue's opposite: it $(bold)pushes entities away$()$(li)an entity shoved $(bold)into a block takes damage based on its speed$()$(li)an entity touching the center → detonation dealing $(bold)2× Blue's$() damage$(li)flies up to 40 blocks; vanishes when it hits a block$(br2)$(bold)Imaginary Technique · Purple$(): $(bold)press F while Blue is charging$() → the two combine and a purple orb is $(bold)fired straight forward$(): $(li)$(bold)destroys every block it hits$() (except bedrock; $(bold)drops nothing$())$(li)hitting an entity deals blast damage equal to $(bold)10× Blue's$()$(br2)Firing costs Cursed Energy (Purple costs 3× Blue/Red). Occupies a technique slot.
